evidence_stage: Post-hoc mechanistic sensitivity analysis on previously analyzed independent-stream confirmation trajectories; no new process trajectories and no independent confirmation claim.
question: For one frozen historical Fault9 monitor, how do normal score variance and detection change as recorded measurement noise shares progressively more components with the noise used by the controller?

panel.selection: All available trajectories in these three roles, no outcome selection or adaptive expansion

coupling.original_noise: sigma*(sequential sum of 12 high32 Philox uniform raw64 words / 2**32 - 6)
coupling.replacement_noise: sigma*(sum first m original uniform components + sum last 12-m independent replacement components - 6), preserving original sequential summation order
coupling.independent_key: first128bits SHA256(study_id + |replacement| + run_id), direct Philox key counter0; disjoint from all original panel keys
coupling.replacement_counter: Use original noise-event starting raw64 word index for each of the 12 replacement components; retain same event across held measurements; reuse same replacement stream across all rho
coupling.channels: All41 measurements at their actual controller-input cached time; held composition channels retain original sample-and-hold events; no-noise initialization observations remain unchanged.
coupling.physical_signal: Hold original controller-input noiseless component and all11 manipulated variables fixed. Add replacement noise through original_measurement+(new_noise-original_noise).
coupling.rho_1: Directly reuse original controller-input values for bit-exact endpoint and baseline replay
coupling.actual_post_update: Separate actual recorded reference. Not asserted to equal rho0, which uses controller-input physical measurement timing.
coupling.interpretation: rho is component-level noise correlation under the original independent-uniform model, not raw measurement-output correlation or a measured industrial parameter. Changes in closed-loop measurement-output joint structure are intended.

noise_recovery.method: Replay original random-call schedule only, using original key; recover controller-input measurement noise events without solving process dynamics.
required_checks: All799 source RAW/RUN_INFO/CHARTS identities match archived file hashes
All960 saved per-record cumulative RNG counts exact per run
Saved D-feed temperature curve agrees with replay within1e-12
Saved complete RNG consumption trace hash exact where available
Direct instrumented full48h normal and Fault9 engineering runs agree with replayed noise event components
Original rho1 and actual post-update CUSUM alarms reproduce archived thresholds and per-run events
noise_recovery.failure_policy: Any mismatch stops processing for investigation; no trajectory dropped or replaced and no tolerance loosened based on scientific outcomes.

monitor.score: same original affine beta/intercept for every arm

calibration.statistic: maximum C over960 records and both sides
calibration.order: write and hash thresholds before new intermediate-coupling evaluation results are calculated
calibration.nominal: 5% marginal finite-run target; report actual400N alarm rate

descriptive_main: normal pooled score variance over400*960 records, ddof1
endpoints.clean: No alarm in records1..160 and crossing in161..960
endpoints.denominator: All200 fault or400 normal runs including prefault alarms and failures

inference.order: normal indices first shape20000x400 then fault indices shape20000x200, default_rng
inference.unit: whole physical run; common indices for all6 arms within role
inference.CI: two-sided95% percentile, linear quantile; marginal descriptive, conditional on frozen model and realized calibration, excludes calibration/training uncertainty

figure: One3panel figure: normal score variance,40h/8h clean detection, normal48h FAR versus rho; actual_post_update horizontal reference clearly separated.
limits: Previously analyzed physical panel, not new independent confirmation
One fixed historical monitor; not performance after retraining at eachrho
Same-time noise decoupling is not an exact reproduction of3second-later post-update
This idealized family does not establish monotonicity or industrial-data performance
One preregistered-within-session replacement realization perrun; no outcome-based rerandomization
No external preregistration or external timestamp
